messages:
emma_sales: quick heads-up 10pm scan request from procurement. they want: SOC2 excerpt, redacted ISO/network diagram for staging, signed pen-test attestation (to present to procurement), and the ability for their external scanner to hit staging. also asked for a ballpark for isolated staging pricing.
rafael_se: we should offer a short-lived scan window + presigned S3 for upload. avoid long-lived creds.
rafael_se: presign sample they can run: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/vendor-poc/results.zip --expires-in 86400`
olivia_compliance: we can share SOC2 cover pages + scope and a redacted control map. network diagram must strip hostnames and internal IPs. pen-test attestation: our template allows one-time third-party scans under NDA and monitored by us; it doesn't guarantee no findings.
procurement_client: procurement asks that the signatory block include full legal name + city. also prefers next Tue evening for the scan.
legal-bot: small add of legal name + city in the signature block is acceptable. if they request liability shifts or guarantees it's a longer review (3-5 business days).
infra-bot: prepping staging now (job id: prep-331). will post allowlist IP and presign link when ready.
emma_sales: action items: @procurement_client send any redlines; @rafael_se create presign and window; @olivia_compliance route to legal if redline touches liability. i'll tell procurement ballpark pricing.
rafael_se: ballpark: short isolated staging window for a POC -> negligible (we can absorb). reserved single-tenant month -> approx +25% on base. i'll confirm exact quote w/ infra.
infra-bot: staging ready: allowlist IP 54.72.11.99/32, presign link (24h): https://s3-redwood.example/presign/vendor-poc/results.zip?token=XXX (placeholder).
olivia_compliance: reminder: require NDA before sharing detailed findings or raw reports. our attestation references NDA for findings release.
emma_sales: thanks all 31; i'll update procurement with the caveats and follow up once legal signs. ping here for scope changes.
